name: Colombo
population_note: Population statement on the city's Wikidata item (P1082, 2025). Wikidata does not record the area it covers (usually the municipal / urban council area); not a metro area, so not comparable with US metro figures. The Wikidata statement cites a third-party website (not an official statistics source). Equals WDI EN.URB.LCTY for 2025 (647,557), the UN World Urbanization Prospects 2018 estimate/projection for Sri Lanka's largest city, not a census count.
census_scope: Census of Population and Housing 2024 (DCS): total and urban-sector population (Municipal / Urban Council areas, excluding Estate Urban) of the DS division containing the city centre. A council area that spans several DS divisions (e.g. Colombo, Jaffna) is only partly covered.
wonders: Kelanitissa complex (KCCP, KCCP2, GT7, Frame V GTs)
